in_marathi.name: Sukhraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukhraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sukhraj is a name of Sanskrit origin meaning 'Happy Ruler'. This name is derived from the words 'sukh' meaning happiness and 'raj' meaning ruler or king.
